prompts.sun: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production planet sprite for a premium black-canvas agent dashboard, Jarvis 3.0. Create exactly ONE isolated celestial body on a genuinely transparent background. This is a richly detailed luminous astronomical illustration, not a UI screenshot. The aesthetic is sophisticated realistic planets gently interpreted as tactile miniature cosmic sculptures: detailed recognizable surface, fine tessellated rocky microfragments and sparse glowing square flecks at the rim, beautiful smooth lighting, high contrast and delicate bloom. Centered, fills about 76% of the square canvas; leave clear transparent margins so glow is not clipped. Main illumination from upper left, shadow on lower right with enough fill to see rich detail. No text, no labels, no icons, no stars in background, no extraneous objects, no eyes or face (a separate animated face will be added in the application). No rectangular panel or opaque background. Subject: the Sun itself, a brilliant warm gold and orange miniature star with intricate cracked plasma cells, luminous white-gold seams, darker amber islands, subtle active solar prominences and a restrained glowing corona. The entire disc is luminous with depth and beautiful surface detail. Strong brightest edges, elegant cinematic rendering, solar texture rather than orange noise. Circular body, no rings.
